concerns.text: Tasks T014a/T014b describe a Knowledge Distillation training loop but fail to specify the data source (audio samples) required to execute the forward pass. FR-001 and US-1 mandate 'training' student models; without a task to load/stream the training dataset (e.g., ESC-50 subset) for the distillation step, the deliverable falls short of the FR's requirement to 'train'.

Task T021 defines filtering criteria (freq > 8kHz OR amp < -40dBFS) but lacks a corresponding task to compute these audio features (e.g., STFT/Amplitude analysis) from raw audio files. FR-002 requires the system to 'filter' the dataset based on these physical properties; without a feature extraction step, the filtering logic cannot be implemented or verified.

Tasks T037/T038 implement model modifications (freezing/pruning) for the ablation study (FR-007) but do not include a task to re-run the inference pipeline (T022) or recalculate metrics (T023) on these modified models. The FR requires 'isolating contributions' via an ablation study; without generating new metrics for the ablated configurations, the task deliverable does not satisfy the FR.

Task T023 claims to compare metrics against GitHub Actions constraints (≤6h, ≤7GB) but does not include a verification step to ensure the CI runner is actually constrained to 2 cores during measurement. Constitution Principle VI mandates that resource profiling occurs on a '2-core CPU environment' to simulate edge constraints; the task omits this critical verification, risking invalid measurements.

Tasks T031/T032 require generating a 'sensitivity report' and plots but do not specify the artifact format or schema for 'sensitivity_report.csv' or 'robustness_curve.png'. SC-003 and SC-004 require these outputs to be 'measurable' and traceable; without a defined schema or format, the deliverable cannot be verified against the Success Criteria.
